name: Pattern Intelligence
description: Pattern Intelligence is an Al agent for ecommerce brand management. Ask questions about your business performance, buy box health, price suppression, inventory gaps, and marketplace trends across Amazon, Walmart, and beyond — and get instant, expert-backed answers. Built on Pattern's 13 years of marketplace expertise and 77+T proprietary data points, Pattern Intelligence monitors your brand around the clock, surfaces risks before they hit your P&L, and resolves them automatically. No more waiting on reports or chasing down answers. Pattern Intelligence gives you the intelligence to lead your business, not just report on it — so ecommerce leaders and brand managers can operate at scale with confidence.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pattern Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pattern Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pattern-agents.ng1.toolsmith.pattern.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pattern Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pattern Intelligence provides these MCP tools: ask_pi, continue_pi_analysis, and list_pi_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pattern Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pattern Intelligence in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Pattern Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pattern Intelligence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pattern Intelligence is developed by Pattern Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
